text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted a smartphone
left all alone on a bench.
There was no one in sight nearby, but—
choice_data_list: Could it belong to a student...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah... That is my sister's smartphone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I wonder where she could have gone...
Perhaps... to the training track?
choice_data_list: I'll go deliver it to her, then.
I'll go deliver it to her, then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I'm sure my sister is...
U-Um...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Ramonu—is—
not here—right now.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—When she is on the track—
she simply—runs—with single-minded focus.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
No matter where—on the track—
you can feel—her aura.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—If not here—she might—
be over—there.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A pity.
The bewitching goddess is currently indisposed.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, that enchanting lady can be observed in this realm.
Graceful as an alluring sea siren, yet thrashing her fins
violently like a beast from the abyss.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
All that she is exists solely for Ragnarok.
Indulging in her own self-discipline for the sake of that single fleeting instant—
such is that noble valkyrie.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And so, you seek an audience with that deity.
Hmph—then let me grant you a new compass.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, really?! You came all the way from the academy
just searching for Ramonu-san?!
choice_data_list: I heard she often visits the cosmetics section here...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right.
Ramonu-san always keeps herself looking truly immaculate.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Especially before she runs.
Whether it's training or an actual race—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's almost like someone getting ready for a date with their beloved.
If you put it in shoujo manga terms, yeah, like an unattainable flower everyone gazes at in awe—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, whoa, I got way too carried away!
Anyway, looks like she isn't here either!

...Nothing else can be done. For now,
I decided to head back to the academy, but—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer-san...!

...In the end, she was at the academy after all.
When I explained how I'd been searching for her—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my. We seemed to have crossed paths.
Those are all places I stopped by today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Honing and grooming oneself. If one is to face a race,
they are all indispensable matters, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that.
I wasn't using it, so I simply left it behind.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: You may leave it anywhere around there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...I am so sorry.
My sister is always like that...
If only I had told you right from the start.
choice_data_list: ...Truly, everything she does is for racing.
...Truly, everything she does is for racing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That is... very true.
It is something I deeply admire about her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
The more I polish, discipline, and pare myself down,
what helplessly swells up within me is love.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu. ...Ah, how I look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That is... very true.
It is something I deeply admire about her.

It had been a day of being led around on a wild chase—
but the "love" Mejiro Ramonu pours into racing
was conveyed loud and clear.
